arxiv-2301-04272.title: Data Distillation: A Survey
arxiv-2301-04272.creator: Noveen Sachdeva nosachde@ucsd.edu, Julian McAuley jmcauley@ucsd.edu
arxiv-2301-04272.description: Abstract The popularity of deep learning has led to the curation of a vast number of massive and multifarious datasets. Despite having close-to-human performance on individual tasks, training parameter-hungry models on large datasets poses multi-faceted problems such as (a) high model-training time; (b) slow research iteration; and (c) poor eco-sustainability.

arxiv-2303-06566.title: ICASSP 2023 Speech Signal Improvement Challenge
arxiv-2303-06566.creator: Ross Cutler, Ando Saabas, Babak Naderi, Nicolae-Cătălin Ristea, Sebastian Braun, Solomiya Branets
arxiv-2303-06566.description: Abstract The ICASSP 2023 Speech Signal Improvement Challenge is intended to stimulate research in the area of improving the speech signal quality in communication systems. The speech signal quality can be measured with SIG in ITU-T P.835 and is still a top issue in audio communication and conferencing systems.

arxiv-2311-04525.title: Motion of microswimmers in cylindrical microchannels
arxiv-2311-04525.creator: Florian A. Overberg, Gerhard Gompper, and Dmitry A. Fedosov
arxiv-2311-04525.description: Abstract Biological and artificial microswimmers often have to propel through a variety of environments, ranging from heterogeneous suspending media to strong geometrical confinement. Under confinement, local flow fields generated by microswimmers, and steric and hydrodynamic interactions with their environment determine the locomotion.

arxiv-2404-01787.title: A Kerr kernel quantum learning machine.
arxiv-2404-01787.creator: Carolyn Wood, Sally Shrapnel, G J Milburn
arxiv-2404-01787.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Carolyn Wood, Sally Shrapnel, G J Milburn. Kernel methods are of current interest in quantum machine learning due to similarities with quantum computing in how they process information in high-dimensional feature (Hilbert) spaces. Kernels are believed to offer particular advantages when they cannot be computed classically, so a kernel matrix with indisputably nonclassical elements is desirable provided it can be generated efficiently in a particular physical machine.

arxiv-2409-09508.title: stable pairs on local curves and Bethe roots
arxiv-2409-09508.creator: Maximilian Schimpf
arxiv-2409-09508.description: Abstract . We give an explicit formula for the descendent stable pair invariants of all (absolute) local curves in terms of certain power series called Bethe roots, which also appear in the physics/representation theory literature. We derive new explicit descriptions for the Bethe roots which are of independent interest.

arxiv-2504-11295.creator: Yeongmin Kim, Sotiris Anagnostidis, Yuming Du, Edgar Schönfeld, Jonas Kohler, Markos Georgopoulos, Albert Pumarola, Ali Thabet, Artsiom Sanakoyeu

arxiv-2509-01974.title: Nonmonotonic change with energy of the mean logarithmic mass of cosmic rays in the knee region: the mechanism of formation of this feature and sources of particles
arxiv-2509-01974.description: Abstract Recently, the Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO) published measurements of the all-particle CR energy spectrum and the mean logarithmic mass of CRs with unprecedented accuracy in 0.3 − - 30 PeV. The mean logarithmic mass shows a nonmonotonic change with energy, a feature observed for the first time.

arxiv-2509-25028.title: The Shape of Surprise: Structured Uncertainty and Co-Creativity in AI Music Tools
arxiv-2509-25028.creator: Eric Browne
arxiv-2509-25028.description: Abstract Randomness plays a pivotal yet paradoxical role in computational music creativity: it can spark novelty, but unchecked chance risks incoherence. This paper presents a thematic review of contemporary AI music systems, examining how designers incorporate randomness and uncertainty into creative practice.

arxiv-2510-16503.title: Sentiment and Volatility in Financial Markets: A Review of BERT and GARCH Applications during Geopolitical Crises
arxiv-2510-16503.creator: Domenica Mino, Cillian Williamson
arxiv-2510-16503.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence techniques have increasingly been applied to understand the complex relationship between public sentiment and financial market behaviour. This study explores the relationship between the sentiment of news related to the Russia-Ukraine war and the volatility of the stock market.

arxiv-2511-04512.title: Preconditioning of GMRES for Helmholtz problems with quasimodes
arxiv-2511-04512.creator: Victorita Dolean \orcidID 0000-0002-5885-1903, Pierre Marchand \orcidID 0000-0002-2522-6837, Axel Modave \orcidID 0000-0002-9145-6585 and Timothée Raynaud \orcidID 0009-0007-1780-4135
arxiv-2511-04512.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Time-harmonic scalar wave propagation can be modeled by the Helmholtz equation: \displaystyle-\Delta u-k^{2}u=f, where k>0 is the wave number, u the unknown field, and f a given source. Boundary conditions (and/or radiation conditions if the problem is defined in an unbounded domain) are imposed to ensure a well-posed problem.

pmc-10575318.creator: Schalk W P Cloete, Johan C Greeff, Cornelius L Nel, Ansie J Scholtz
pmc-10575318.description: igh. Within-breed selection in Merinos resulted in lines resisting challenges from internal parasites, blowfly strike, and sheep lice. Within-breed selection in Merinos resulted in lines resisting challenges from internal parasites, blowfly strike, and sheep lice. Lamb survival benefitted from selection for number of lambs weaned per ewe mated, being able to resist cold stress during a winter lambing season.

pmc-11403951.title: Predicting blood transfusion needs in colorectal surgery at a university hospital in Saudi Arabia: insights into anemia, malnutrition, and surgical factors
pmc-11403951.creator: Sara Farsi
pmc-11403951.description: BackgroundIn Saudi Arabia, nearly a quarter of a hospital’s blood supply is consumed in operating rooms. However, blood is a scarce resource, and its unavailability has led to the cancellation of many surgeries. This study aims to identify risk factors for perioperative blood transfusion in colorectal surgery, thus providing valuable insights for better blood management and transfusion planning.

pmc-11421902.title: Mapping threatened Thai bovids provides opportunities for improved conservation outcomes in Asia
pmc-11421902.creator: Wantida Horpiencharoen, Renata L Muylaert, Jonathan C Marshall, Reju Sam John, Antony J Lynam, Alex Riggio, Alexander Godfrey, Dusit Ngoprasert, George A Gale, Eric Ash, Francesco Bisi, Giacomo Cremonesi, Gopalasamy Reuben Clements, Marnoch Yindee, Nay Myo Shwe, Chanratana Pin, Thomas N E Gray, Saw
pmc-11421902.description: Wild bovids provide important ecosystem functions as seed dispersers and vegetation modifiers. Five wild bovids remain in Thailand: gaur (Bos gaurus), banteng (Bos javanicus), wild water buffalo (Bubalus arnee), mainland serow (Capricornis sumatraensis) and Chinese goral (Naemorhedus griseus). Their populations and habitats have declined substantially and become fragmented by land-use change.

pmc-11492373.title: Revealing the Structure of Sheer N-Acetylglucosamine, an Essential Chemical Scaffold in Glycobiology
pmc-11492373.creator: Elena
pmc-11492373.description: We explored the conformational landscape of N-acetyl-α-d-glucosamine (α-GlcNAc), a fundamental chemical scaffold in glycobiology. Solid samples were vaporized by laser ablation, expanded in a supersonic jet, and characterized by broadband chirped pulse Fourier transform microwave spectroscopy. In the isolation conditions of the jet, three different structures of GlcNAc have been discovered.

pmc-11510048.title: Advances in Chitosan-Based Smart Hydrogels for Colorectal Cancer Treatment
pmc-11510048.creator: Urszula Piotrowska, Klaudia Orzechowska, Guendalina Zuccari
pmc-11510048.description: Despite advancements in early detection and treatment in developed countries, colorectal cancer (CRC) remains the third most common malignancy and the second-leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Conventional chemotherapy, a key option for CRC treatment, has several drawbacks, including poor selectivity and the development of multiple drug resistance, which often lead to severe side effects.

pmc-11564007.title: Regulatory roles of NAMPT and NAD+ metabolism in uterine leiomyoma progression: Implications for ECM accumulation, stemness, and microenvironment
pmc-11564007.creator: Yi-Fen Chiang, Ko-Chieh Huang, Tsui-Chin Huang, Hsin-Yuan Chen, Mohamed Ali, Ayman Al-Hendy, Pei-Shen Huang, Shih-Min Hsia
pmc-11564007.description: Uterine leiomyoma (UL), commonly referred to as benign tumors, is characterized by excessive cell proliferation, extracellular matrix (ECM) accumulation, and the presence of stem cell-like properties. Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) metabolism, regulated in part by nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT), plays a crucial role in these pathological processes and has emerged as a potential therapeutic target.

pmc-12571730.title: The effect of Hp infection on dyslipidemia in Asia and out of Asia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12571730.creator: Kong-jin Quan, Zhen-peng Huang, Sha Nie, Xiao-xiao Li
pmc-12571730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionHelicobacter pylori (Hp) infection is a major public health problem worldwide. Similarly, millions suffer from dyslipidemia, which is a risk factor for cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. This study aimed to explore whether Hp infection affects dyslipidemia.MethodsThe search databases included PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Embase, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, Chinese sci-tech periodicals, and Sino-Med, from database construction to September 2024.

pmc-12693959.title: Plasmonic Su–Schrieffer–Heeger chains with strong coupling amplitudes
pmc-12693959.creator: Benedikt Schurr, Matthias Hensen, Luisa Brenneis, Philipp Kessler, Jin Qin, Victor Lisinetskii, Ronny Thomale, Tobias Brixner, Bert Hecht
pmc-12693959.description: Plasmonic many-particle systems with precisely tuned resonances and coupling strengths can exhibit emergent collective properties governed by universal principles. In one-dimensional chains with alternating couplings, known as Su–Schrieffer–Heeger (SSH) systems, this includes the formation of topologically protected mid-gap modes whose intensities localize at the chain’s ends.

pmc-12983326.title: Approaching Serious Illness Conversations in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Using Telehealth
pmc-12983326.creator: Erica Scirocco, Sabrina Paganoni, Kate Brizzi
pmc-12983326.description: Purpose of ReviewGiven the lack of consensus on serious illness conversations (SIC) in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) by using telehealth, we aim to provide practical strategies in this setting.Recent FindingsOver the past 5 years, there has been substantial growth in telehealth, especially after the global COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-13166432.creator: Catherine E Mosher, Stella Snyder, Marcia F Burns, Gregory A Durm, DuyKhanh P Ceppa, Shadia I Jalal, Thomas J Birdas, Kenneth A Kesler, Lawrence H Einhorn, Nasser Hanna

pmc-13213468.title: Larval Habitat Characteristics of Mosquitoes (Diptera: Culicidae) in Andimeshk County of Khuzistan Province, Southwestern Iran (2019–2020)
pmc-13213468.creator: Hamid Kassiri, Morteza Zamanizadeh, Shahyad Azari-Hamidian
pmc-13213468.description: Background:Mosquitoes (Diptera: Culicidae), with their blood-sucking behavior, are known important vectors of certain pathogens. Since no research has been done on the habitat characteristics of mosquito larvae in Andimeshk County of Khuzistan Province, southwestern Iran, this study aimed to determine these features in the county during 2019–2020.

pmc-13504788.creator: Merter Güçlü, Hatice Selin Güçlü
pmc-13504788.description: BackgroundEarly childhood caries remains a major global public health concern. As parents and children increasingly rely on digital platforms for health information, the quality and reliability of online educational resources become critical. Despite the abundance of general oral health content, studies specifically evaluating child-oriented toothbrushing instructions remain scarce.
